title: APX-Hardness of Computing Lipschitz Constants for Multi-Parametric Quadratic Programs
summary: Computing the Lipschitz constant of the solution map of a multi-parametric quadratic program is important for the analysis of optimization-based control. This problem is governed by three factors: the parameter dimension, the number of decision variables, and the number of constraints. While empirical evidence has long suggested exponential complexity, a rigorous complexity-theoretic proof has been lacking.
